{{Otheruses|Old Ways}}
The '''Old Ways''' was a set of traditions and cultural norms that the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] observed before the collapse of the [[Hutt Empire]] during the [[Hutt Cataclysms]], which ended in [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]].<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
